question: The Union Minister of Communications, Mr. Jyotiraditya Scindia, during his keynote at the World Wi-Fi Day Conference in June 2025, projected Wi-Fi to become a ₹1,83,000 crores (US$ 21.2 billion) sector in India by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thu Jul 27 1905 00:00:00 GMT+0521 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Minister of Communications, **Mr. Jyotiraditya Scindia**, delivered a keynote address at the **World Wi-Fi Day Conference** held in **June 2025**.
 
• During the conference, the Minister projected that Wi-Fi would grow into a sector worth **₹1,83,000 crores (US$ 21.2 billion)** in **India**.
 
• The statement emphasized that this growth would occur by **Thu Jul 27 1905 00:00:00 GMT+0521 (India Standard Time)**, which aligns with the projected timeline mentioned in the question.
 
• Other options provided in the question, such as **Sat Jul 22 1905**, **Tue Aug 01 1905**, and **Sun Aug 06 1905**, do not fit the correct timeline as per the Minister’s projection.
 
• This projection highlights the anticipated expansion of Wi-Fi infrastructure in India, driven by increasing digitalization and demand for connectivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Wi-Fi Day:**

 
 
• World Wi-Fi Day is celebrated globally to promote initiatives aimed at improving wireless connectivity.
 
• It is an effort to bridge the **digital divide** and ensure that Wi-Fi access becomes universally available.
 
• The day is supported by global organizations and aims to foster discussions on technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Wi-Fi Sector in India:**
 
 
• India's Wi-Fi infrastructure has witnessed significant growth due to increasing demand for internet connectivity.
 
• Major initiatives like **Digital India** aim to enhance internet accessibility across urban and rural areas.
 
• Public Wi-Fi projects, including **PM-WANI** (Prime Minister’s Wi-Fi Access Network Interface), have contributed to this growth.
 
 
 
• **PM-WANI Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched by the Government of India, PM-WANI aims to establish a framework for expanding public Wi-Fi networks.
 
• It focuses on providing affordable and accessible internet services in underserved areas.
 
• Public Data Office (PDO) and Public Data Office Aggregators (PDOA) are integral parts of this initiative.
 
 
 
• **Role of Communications Ministry:**
 
 
• The Ministry of Communications is responsible for implementing policies to improve connectivity across India.
 
• Its initiatives focus on enhancing broadband penetration, mobile connectivity, and Wi-Fi accessibility.
 
• It works closely with private players, public organizations, and other stakeholders to achieve these goals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Digital India Initiative:**

 
 
• Launched in **2015**, Digital India aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society.
 
• The initiative focuses on improving internet accessibility, digital literacy, and e-governance.
 
• Several schemes under Digital India have contributed to the growth of the Wi-Fi sector.
 
 
 
• **Global Wi-Fi Trends:**
 
 
• The global Wi-Fi market is expected to grow significantly, driven by advancements in technology and increasing internet demand.
 
• India's contribution to this growth is substantial due to its large population and rapid digitalization.
 
• Efforts to enhance Wi-Fi infrastructure are critical for bridging the digital divide and boosting economic growth.
